title: The AI Family Tree
creator: Katie Jo Schuman
subject: Generative AI Economics
description: An interactive vis-network diagram showing how Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Networks, Generative AI, Foundation Models, and Large Language Models nest inside one another, with a dashed 'built on' edge distinguishing the neural network mechanism from the chain of nested scopes.

learningObjectives: Classify Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Neural Network, Generative AI, Foundation Model, and Large Language Model according to their nested is-a-subset-of relationships
Explain why every LLM is a foundation model while not every foundation model is an LLM
Distinguish the 'built on' relationship between Deep Learning and Neural Network from the 'contains' relationship linking the other terms
Identify which level of the tree a given cost claim applies to

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Predict-then-reveal step-through followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: Which of these seven terms is the broadest, and which is the narrowest?
Is every foundation model a large language model?
Why is the arrow to Neural Network drawn differently from the others?
If a vendor says their product is 'AI-powered', what have they actually told you about its cost?
commonMisconceptions: Treating AI, ML, DL, and LLM as interchangeable synonyms rather than nested categories
Assuming every foundation model is a large language model
Reading 'Deep Learning is built on Neural Networks' as another level of nesting
Believing that the label 'AI' implies anything specific about running cost
assessmentOpportunities: Have students reconstruct the nesting order from memory
Ask for a counterexample to 'every foundation model is an LLM'
Give a cost claim and ask which level of the tree it belongs to
